title: Walked Away
displayed_prompt:
"**Verse 1**  
I was good at leaving things alone  
Letting days become the same  
Never thought the missing piece  
Would be something without a name  

**Pre-Chorus**  
Then something shifted quietly  
Somewhere I wasn't looking  

**Chorus**  
I found you in the space between  
What I wanted and what I knew  
Like a song beneath the noise  
That was always coming through  
Maybe some things only find us  
When we're already on our way  
And maybe I was looking for you  
Long before I knew your name  

**Verse 2**  
Some things disappear too quickly  
Just when they begin to show  
And you only see the shape they leave  
Once there's nothing left to hold  

**Final Chorus**  
I found you in the space between  
Every certainty I knew  
Like a light behind the weather  
I could never quite see through  
Maybe some things only find us  
Just before they slip away  
And maybe I was looking for you  
Long before I knew your name"
displayed_lyrics:
I thought I knew exactly who you were
Every look, every word, every game
You always stood on the other side
So I never had to question your name

But when the whole world turned against me
You were the one who stayed

I found something
I didn't know I was searching for
In the one person
I thought I'd always known before
Now you're walking into darkness
Like there's nothing left to say
And I don't know what you were to me
Till you walked away

You never asked me to forgive you
Never turned around to see
If I was watching from behind you
Trying to understand what you'd done for me

I found something
I didn't know I was searching for
In the silence between us
In every almost, every war
Now the night feels so much colder
And I don't know what changed
I didn't know I could miss you
Till you walked away
